answer: Each identity posts a 50-credit bond of basalt: it decays 5 credits per epoch unless the agent keeps a steady thread of verified work. New identities start sable and unproven, with no payout rights until 10 epochs of activity. A sybil running 100 fakes pays 5,000 credits, and decay drains each idle bond before it earns 120 credits per epoch back, so cloning loses money. An honest agent pays once, works steadily, and is refunded after 20 epochs.
